parameters.name: NewResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the new resource group to which you want to move the scaling group.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the scaling group resides.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The ID of the scaling group whose resource group you want to change.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The resource type. Only scaling groups are supported. Set the value to scalinggroup.
